settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Choose the application hostname, certificate and optional NethServer sign-in settings. Saving starts the dedicated database and C0 application.
settings.host_help: DNS name pointing to this NS8 node, without https:// or a path.
settings.host_invalid: Enter a valid fully qualified DNS hostname.
settings.certificate_help: HTTPS is handled by NethServer. With this option off, NethServer uses its configured certificate. Certificate requests require public DNS and network access.
settings.domain_already_used_in_traefik: This hostname is already used by another application.
settings.certificate_failed: Certificate request failed. Check the DNS and network settings, then retry or disable the certificate request.
settings.owner_help: An existing account in the selected user domain. Ownership is pinned to its LDAP identity; the cluster administrator login is separate.
settings.sharing_help: The owner has Admin access. Additional Reader, Editor or Admin accounts are admitted in the C0 application after their first sign-in attempt.
settings.auth_options_failed: Cannot load user domains or identity providers. Verify the NS8 account domain and ns8-idp setup.
settings.identity_required: Select an identity provider, user domain and owner account.
settings.identity_invalid: Verify the selected domain/provider and the existing owner account.
settings.retrieval_privacy: Embedding providers receive extracted text and search queries. Relevance scorers receive queries and bounded evidence excerpts. Keep disabled until the provider and data handling are approved. Text search works without them.
settings.key_saved: A key is saved. Leave blank to preserve it on the same endpoint.
settings.key_empty: No key is saved. Changing the endpoint clears its existing key.
settings.embedding_send_dimensions: Send dimensions to a compatible provider
settings.threshold_help: Calibrate this probability threshold for the pinned model and corpus. Mock test scores do not demonstrate real model quality.
settings.limit_candidates: Ranking candidates (at least returned results, at most 64)
settings.retrieval_invalid: Invalid retrieval settings. Check HTTPS endpoints, pinned models, keys and numeric limits.
